solves.reasoning: (A) participate — social media에 참여. (B) mutuality — 상호성 위에 세워진 관계. (C) expanding — 'who you know' 확장.
(A) engage — successfully engage. (B) reinforce — 정체성 강화. (C) straightforward — simple and straightforward.
(A) capital — social capital. (B) stresses — Lin's work stresses. (C) shapes — shapes our experience.
③ hostility — 상호성(mutuality) 자리에 적대감은 부적절. built on mutuality.
② fall apart — ties가 pay off 해야 하는데 fall apart는 반대 의미.
④ limiting — 'to greater and greater lengths' 앞에 expanding이 맞고 limiting은 반대.
engage — 'successfully ____ in social media' 문맥에서 engage가 적합.
reinforce — 'We ____ our identities through our online presentation'에서 강화하다.
straightforward — 'simple and ____'에서 형용사 straightforward가 문맥상 적합.
participate = engage. 둘 다 '참여하다' 의미.
concept = notion. '개념' 의미 동일.
emphasizes = stresses. '강조하다' 의미 동일.
reduce는 increase의 반의어. maintain은 유지, measure/collect는 다른 의미축.
convoluted(복잡한)는 straightforward(단순명료)의 반의어.
(A) social capital = 자산/자본. (B) capital of country = 수도.
uncomplicated and easy = straightforward. 영영 정의 정확 일치.
may + 동사원형. may __________ (pay) off → pay.
Lin's work(3인칭 단수 주어) + stress → stresses.
expected returns — 'investment in social relations with ____' = expected returns.
greater and greater lengths — 'expanding our who you know to ____'.
